title: Story2Board → StorySync integration contract (prompt-split interface)
purpose: A concrete interface contract and Python adapter sketch showing how Story2Board's LLM prompt-split output (one reference prompt + N scene prompts) can be passed directly into StorySync's batch-prompt input, with a preflight check that validates the shared character description before any diffusion call is made. Useful for anyone wiring these two training-free systems together.
